name: Flak armour
text: Basic body protection. The save improves by one against Blast and flame template attacks.

name: Mesh armour
text: Flexible mesh worn over the body.

name: Light carapace
text: Moulded plates covering most of the body.

name: Armoured undersuit
text: Combined armour: adds one to the wearer's armour save and stacks with one standard armour item. A fighter with no armour counts as having a 7+ save.

name: Respirator
text: Adds two to the wearer's Toughness against Gas weapons.

name: Filter plugs
text: Adds one to the wearer's Toughness against Gas weapons; single use.

name: Photo-goggles
text: The wearer can shoot through smoke clouds, ignores low light and gets +1 on Initiative tests against Flash.

name: Drop-rig
text: Allows a controlled descent from an edge. Zone Mortalis boards are flat, so it has no effect in v1.

name: Skinblade
text: A hidden blade that helps a captured fighter escape. Campaign only, so it has no effect in v1.
